models_evaluated: machine-learning classifier on hyperspectral imaging spectra (400-1000 nm)

links.outcome: Effect of skin pigmentation type on HSI classification accuracy
links.effect: No significant effect of skin type on classification accuracy across skin pigmentation types.
links.quote: Full-spectrum analysis substantially improved non-cellulitis edema versus healthy classification (patient-level AUC: 0.72 vs. 0.41; pixel-level AUC: 0.78 vs. 0.50), with no significant effect of skin type on accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Benchmarking full-spectrum machine-learning classification against standard spectral indices

screen.reason: Evaluates a machine learning model applied to hyperspectral imaging data collected in an emergency department to detect cellulitis and edema across skin pigmentation types, but evaluates model performance alone without testing an operational deployment practice or guardrail.
